bio: Treat yourself to an indulgent Afternoon Tea at Grand Pacific, Manchester. This grade II listed building has been transformed into an elegant yet comfortable and relaxing dining experience.  The historic building still boasts some of its original features, restored to complement a classic and traditional interior. Amongst this includes palm trees and a 24-seat Long Bar, providing a South-East Asia inspired look.  Rejoice in a quintessentially English Afternoon Tea with a sophisticated twist on classic flavours. Grand Pacific's High Tea features savoury delights alongside a plethora of sweet treats paying homage to the season.
